items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Uh our landlord's daughter, Camille, her name was.

ctx.x: You know, we're forgetting about where you went to school and all that. Oh, no, I'm not forgetting.

I attended, you see, I, we rented from some people by the name of Lavazzo. So some of our neighbors was, uh, the Champ and B-Sent, the Lavazzo and the Palmers. I remember that very well. And, uh, when I first entered the school, elementary school, I entered in fifth grade, because they had, uh, there's a school teacher. She was a graduate from Straits University. Uh, our landlord's daughter, Camille, her name was. So I went to this pay school. And so when I, when I, when I first attended Tomlin' Farm, I started…
